import sys
from collections import Counter

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    numbers = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    count = Counter(numbers)
    max_count = max(count.values())
    if max_count > 2 or (max_count == 2 and len(count) == 1):
        print("NO")
    else:
        print("YES")

main()
